meta.name: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess with Zero Believers
meta.description: An isekai fantasy where an ordinary gamer reincarnates without special powers, teams up with a minor goddess, and rises from the weakest to the strongest in a new world.

videos.title: Makoto Takatsuki Becomes a Believer
videos.overview: Makoto awakens with weak Stats & Unique Skills that seem useless, but he meets a goddess after venturing out.

videos.title: Makoto Takatsuki Embarks on a Quest
videos.overview: Makoto visits Fujiyan to appraise the goddess' dagger, then begins his life as an adventurer slaying goblins.

videos.title: Makoto Takatsuki Gains a Party Member
videos.overview: Makoto gains his first party member. They hunt goblins, train, and then go hunt bison with Jean and Emily.

videos.title: Makoto Takatsuki Synchronizes
videos.overview: Attacked by a griffon, Makoto braves immolation to synchronize with Lucy to control her magic and defeat it.

videos.title: Makoto Takatsuki Explores a Dungeon
videos.overview: Makoto's party braves a rare dungeon discovered by Fujiyan and accidentally awakens an ancient Titanea.

videos.title: Makoto Takatsuki Meets a Dragon
videos.overview: Makoto meets some old classmates and braves the dungeon Labyrinthos, fighting novice hunters and a dragon.

videos.title: Makoto Takatsuki Helps With Her Revenge
videos.overview: Makoto's party helps Aya exact her revenge on the harpy flock that killed her lamia mother.

videos.title: Makoto Takatsuki Speaks to the Elementals
